name: Palacio Duhau - Park Hyatt Buenos Aires
positioning: Recoleta hotel set across a restored 1934 palace and the contemporary Posadas building, with gardens, an underground art gallery and butler service in the Palace rooms
best_for: Travelers who want a historic palace setting in Recoleta
Food and wine lovers interested in afternoon tea, wine and cheese tastings and plant-based dining

facts.text: The hotel is in the Recoleta neighborhood of Buenos Aires.
The hotel is made up of two buildings: a restored 1934 Palace and the contemporary Posadas building.
Conde Nast Traveler describes the hotel as a restored neoclassical mansion from the 1930s.
Ahin Spa has a short-course swimming pool and a gym.
La Vinoteca has a cheese cellar and offers wine and cheese tastings.
Gioia Cocina Botanica serves a plant-based menu.
Duhau Patisserie is the hotel's pastry boutique, offering macarons and petits gateaux.
The hotel has its own flower boutique, Floreria del Duhau, which also welcomes visitors from the community.
In-room dining is available 24 hours a day.
The hotel welcomes housebroken dogs and provides a bed, a bowl and treats.
Valet parking includes private VIP parking with direct access to the Palace suites.

highlights.text: Paseo de las Artes Duhau is an underground art gallery at the hotel showing temporary exhibitions.
Los Salones del Piano Nobile has original frescoes and boiserie and serves a traditional afternoon tea.
Butlers unpack on arrival, press clothes and shine shoes at no charge.
The hotel's gardens are surrounded by ancient trees and have a cascading fountain.
Oak Bar has medieval oak paneling and a garden-view terrace, serving cocktails, Scotch whiskies and tapas.

considerations.text: Ezeiza International Airport is 34 kilometers from the hotel; Aeroparque Jorge Newbery is 7.1 kilometers away.
WhataHotel notes premium luxury pricing that reflects the hotel's exclusive positioning.
WhataHotel notes the formal atmosphere may not suit travelers looking for a casual experience.
